items.reason: The added BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.java:237-242 rebuilds credentials from the original list, while validation at :334-340 never removes accepted codes; RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel.java:65-71 consequently recreates every code with numbering starting at one. RecoveryAuthnCodeInputLoginBean.java:21 therefore keeps requesting code 1, and RecoveryAuthnCodesFormAuthenticator.java:85-91 never detects exhaustion or requests replacement codes. This is a functional defect in the test storage provider introduced by this PR.
